title: Diagnose why oem_lh's SQL analytics endpoint stopped showing new gold_quality_history rows after 2026-08-12
description: Found 2026-10-17 while closing task-076. Erik ran a point-in-time query on oem_lh's SQL analytics endpoint (WHERE producer = 'data_quality_checks' AND refresh_timestamp = MAX for that producer): the newest row it returned was 2026-08-12 16:06:16. The same day, live DAX on the OEMInsightBI model (Direct Lake over the same Delta table) showed data_quality_checks rows through 2026-10-17T04:18:12.973 (5,038 rows) and silver_to_gold rows through 04:07 today. So the endpoint is about two months behind the Delta table, at least for gold_quality_history. Unverified: whether other tables are stale too, whether the gap is the endpoint's metadata sync (or a Delta change on/after 2026-08-12 that the sync can't process), and whether the endpoint's own MAX(refresh_timestamp) without the producer filter is also 2026-08-12. Do: (1) measure staleness per gold/silver table (endpoint MAX timestamp or row count vs Delta's latest version), read-only; (2) establish the cause on live evidence (e.g. the endpoint's metadata sync status / last sync time, and DESCRIBE HISTORY on gold_quality_history around 2026-08-12); (3) propose the fix. Any write action (a metadata refresh trigger, a table change) needs Erik's OK first; (4) once fixed, confirm the endpoint returns this morning's run; (5) if the endpoint is a reader anyone relies on, decide with Erik whether staleness needs a check. Note: memory already records that the endpoint's schema cache lags hours behind column adds; this is a data lag of weeks.
acceptanceCriteria: Staleness is measured per table on the SQL analytics endpoint against the Delta tables, on live evidence.
The cause of the endpoint missing gold_quality_history rows after 2026-08-12 is established on live evidence.
After the fix (with Erik's OK for any write action), the endpoint returns the most recent orchestrator run's data_quality_checks rows.
Docs or spec text that describe the endpoint are updated if the cause changes how it should be used (spec via /iterate).
notes: [CREATED 2026-10-17] Erik approved creating this task ('yes, make the task') after task-076's completion surfaced the finding. Evidence in task-076 notes [COMPLETED 2026-10-17].
